name: Mei Lian Tan
bio:
Mei Lian Tan's journey into the high-octane world of motorsport began unexpectedly after a career in corporate communications. After handling crisis communications for a major bank, she found her skills were surprisingly applicable to the fast-paced, unpredictable environment of racing. She joined Brad Jones Racing five years ago, bringing a meticulous approach to media relations and sponsorship management.

Mei Lian is known for her unwavering commitment to presenting a polished, professional image for the team. She meticulously crafts press releases, manages social media engagement, and cultivates relationships with key journalists and influencers. Her demanding nature ensures that every detail is perfect, and that the team's message is consistently on point. She has a knack for turning potential controversies into opportunities for positive brand building.

What sets Mei Lian apart is her understanding of both the technical aspects of racing and the emotional investment of fans. She excels at translating complex engineering jargon into compelling stories that resonate with a broader audience, connecting the team with its fans on a deeper level.

physical.hairStyle: Shoulder-length, subtly layered, often pulled back in a neat bun.
physical.description: Mei Lian possesses a sharp, intelligent gaze and a perpetually composed demeanor.

quirks: Always carries a small notebook filled with meticulously organized to-do lists.
Insists on using a specific brand of black ink pen for all official documents.
Has a habit of adjusting her glasses even when they are perfectly in place.
